---
name: Tester feedback
about: Tell us how a repo-interview session went
title: "Tester feedback: "
labels: tester-feedback
---

**Which way did you try?** (terminal interview / pull request comments)

**What kind of project?** (language, roughly how big; no need to share the code)

**1. How useful were the questions, from 1 (useless) to 5 (I'd want these in a real interview or review)?**

**2. Best question, and worst question:**

**3. Did any score feel unfair? Which one, and why?**

**4. What confused you or broke during setup?**

**5. Would you use it again? For what?**
